metadata.title: WordPress Content Publisher
metadata.description: Draft-only WordPress article and media publisher with REST fallback, throttling, idempotency, SEO fields, and verification.
metadata.author: RAINMOJO SO

configuration.purpose: Upload a validated article package and all associated media as a verified WordPress draft.

prerequisites: engine.mode has been read before choosing the generic publisher or native adapter
phases: For generic, require publish_ready and run the shared draft publisher
For generic, verify post, taxonomy, links, SEO fields, and media individually
For client_native, invoke only preflight, publish_draft, and verify_only
Use verify-only recovery and never retry an ambiguous write
success_criteria: Title, slug, content, links, taxonomy, featured media, inline media, and SEO fields match the package
Media alt, title, caption, credit, dimensions, and identity match the package
Every media item is readable through the REST API
